operations.authority: Fresh identified platform operator in the configured control-plane organization; tenant OpsWrite is insufficient
operations.requestBinding: Path organization and reservation UUID plus one immutable, reservation-attributable invoice-line attestation; no aggregate allocation or idempotency header

items.description: Existing named hosting-resource fields; no arbitrary metrics metadata. Not a commercial meter.

storageBreakdowns.description: Current logical occupied-byte snapshot published atomically with the complete Storage application; empty when no current complete snapshot is available. Not monthly provider activity or physical infrastructure usage.

Grant.description: A revision preserves purchaseId, authorizationId, quoteId, full initial snapshot, billingPeriodId, paymentAttemptId and financial interval; only lifecycle fields may change. The embedded quote digest and quoteId must match.

grants.description: Complete staged revisions including scheduled transitions and revocation tombstones; publish only after all pinned pages validate.

GrantPageResponse.description: Snapshot and every embedded grant must match the trusted requested installation/environment/organization. Exact page and completed-snapshot replay is a no-op. A missing checkpoint differs from source revision zero.

supportedLimitBytes.description: Largest schedule limit supported by this native writer; not free disk space. Missing or null evidence cannot authorize allocation.

reviewDisposition.Pay: Route identity, immutable grant/snapshot replay and scoped idempotency amendments incorporated
reviewDisposition.Providers Manager: Catalog/lifecycle and R1/R2 schedule-enforcement/guard-review amendments incorporated
reviewDisposition.Portal: Discovery, permissions, quote increases, recovery, freshness, revision receipts and reservation migration requests incorporated
reviewDisposition.resolution: Data final decision establishes v1.0.0; further unanimous owner acceptance is not a prerequisite

publicHttpTransport.payBuyerAuthentication: Existing Login session and CSRF validation
publicHttpTransport.body: operation requestSchema command; guest HTTP adapter moves delegation and request key to Invocation, never forwards headers to extension-services
publicHttpTransport.dataOwnerAuthentication: Existing Portal owner facade verified actor; no delegation header replaces that authentication
publicHttpTransport.statusAndReadResponses: Cache-Control: private, no-store for billing actions, authorizations, preview and status; never shared across actors

decision.authority: User delegated final contract authority to Data
decision.changeControl: Data owns versioned amendments; teams report concrete implementation defects without blocking independent work
launchRequirements: Configured and approved commercial installation, quantities and prices
Native authorization, idempotency, metering and concurrency tests

implementationNotes.guardPolicy: Native operator review, durable approval and all-applicable guard enforcement implemented; commercial admission and sales remain disabled.
implementationNotes.siteMigration: Native owner HTTP bootstrap, frozen-source import, reserve, reconcile and release are implemented. Deploy commits reservations in the site/job transaction; there is no caller-supplied commit acknowledgement. Allocation triggers cover native Deploy/Fleet writes, revival and deletion. Imported uncertainty remains counted and the frozen source is retained. The alternative extension-service bindings and standalone commit route remain unavailable; Portal uses its established owner HTTP transport. Installed activation remains unverified.
implementationNotes.localQuotaAdmin: Operator browser read binding published; native projection remains unavailable until Data persists validated runtime acknowledgements.

accountingPolicy.categoryBudgets: One explicit organization budget mapping per category; pooled allowances are published once. Images share Intelligence. Site sublimits further restrict their organization pool.
accountingPolicy.funding: Actual adapter credential account; SEO/Ahrefs and Voice/ElevenLabs require customer-owned credentials. No Developer service amounts are inferred.
accountingPolicy.legacy: Old units, quotes and grants remain immutable history. No conversion of request counts or historical estimates into credits. Retired meter IDs cannot authorize new purchases.
accountingPolicy.configuration: accountingVersion=2 explicitly enables native cutover. BaseAllowance.categories identifies budget membership. Purchased credit reset/expiry must be explicitly configured; unsupported policies remain unavailable.
accountingPolicy.units: credit is an independent integer customer accounting unit. Supplier pricing uses integer micro-USD and rational rates; credit is not one supplier dollar.
accountingPolicy.coverage: Native managed-provider admission is implemented; direct/local writers and remote runtime acknowledgement remain incomplete. Sales disabled until complete coverage, approved configuration and joint activation tests.

pricingConfiguration.source: Platform-owned provider profile metadata.accountingV2; native shared-account tenant profiles resolve the matching platform profile, never tenant pricing.
pricingConfiguration.authority: Platform operator OpsWrite with revision-fenced profile autosave; native SES/X profiles permit accounting-rule changes only. Admission snapshots the pricing profile ID, revision, configured version and complete rates.
pricingConfiguration.notProductApproval: No synthetic fixture or workbook scenario configures a production allowance or rate.

operationIdentity.scope: authorized organization; site, operation, provider profile and request digest are immutable
operationIdentity.email: Existing delivery ID plus recipient index, or hashed durable notification/channel, calendar-effect or extension-outbox identity in X-Cedros-Operation-Key. No fresh trace ID is a retry key.
operationIdentity.replay: Resume/reconcile the existing reservation; never dispatch a second paid operation from a retry. Native callers without a persistent key still require durable caller integration.

accountingPolicy.customerCharging: Measured successful work debits priced credits; email debits authoritative accepted recipients even on partial failure. Supplier measurements remain recorded for failed work. Missing measurements retain the reservation and block further Cedros-funded admissions until reconciliation.
accountingPolicy.purchases: New offers require new immutable offer versions in credit or recipient units. Old request/image/voice/SEO grant snapshots remain financial history; never convert them into credits. Purchased credit reset/expiry is explicitly configured; the native ledger currently supports recurring calendar-month capacity with no rollover only.
